description:
Welcome to SkyBlockPE

We are an amazing Skyblock server with awesome people like you! Join today and build your own dream island!

Features

• Spacious islands - Play solo or invite your friends

• Challenges - Complete challenges to gain items and levels

• Ranks - Unlock new ranks by gaining levels, what rank will you be?

• Crates - Get rewards by voting daily and participating in events

• Mob spawners - Create awesome mob grinders

• Shops - At spawn and on player islands

• PvP - What's better than PvP?

• No resets - Skyblock since 2016!

Compatible with game versions 1.20 and newer
